'''Urdur''' was a remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Urdur system/Legends|Urdur system]]. It was located so far from its [[Star/Legends|sun]] that it was perpetually frozen. It was the site of an [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] base run by [[Klaus Vandangante/Legends|Klaus "Doc" Vandangante]] after his escape from [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]].
